reviews.comment: He is one of the GOATs of the philosophy department, IMO. I've taken all of his courses and highly recommend taking him. Teaches the concepts in a fun way with a lot of discussion. It's almost impossible to not understand what's going on. Lectures are very entertaining. You won't regret taking any of his classes.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof. Sansom's lectures are super interesting because they rely on student examples; it helps with understanding. He's SO funny and will help you with your test prepping in a way you that you will know what you're talking about. He does provide the reading material, and it's difficult to understand until you go over it in lecture. Absolute GOAT.

4 exams including the final, lowest one gets dropped (AKA no final). Hilarious, no homework. You have one presentation and the exams were in person writings where you're given the prompt a week before the exam which makes them easy A's. I felt like I learned a lot in his class because I didn't feel pressured academically and could enjoy his class.
He was ok.

Loved this class! His lectures were really interesting and there is a lot of socratic method in class and in lab. The exams topics are intense but it was very interesting and I loved talking about those types of topics. Highly highly recommend this class if you want something work-light but thought-heavy.

Dr. Sansom is a great prof. His classes are purely discussion based with 4 written exams (lowest dropped) and a presentation grade. The exam topics are kind of difficult, however, you get to know the question a few days before hand and can run your draft through him or the awesome TAs. I'm definitely not a PHIL person, but this is a good elective.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: HE IS AMAZING!! Dr. Sansom is literally my favorite professor at tamu. He is hilarious and absolutely loves teaching us philosophy. His classes are discussion based, which makes them SO INTERESTING. I'm never bored in his classes, and the philosophy is mind-bending. The readings and essays are on challenging topics, but it is worth the effort!!!!

This class really isn't difficult at all, the only things you're graded on are 4 papers written in class (lowest dropped) and one oral presentation defending/objecting a concept. Graded by TA's - all very chill. I found Dr. Sansom to be really funny and entertaining! Attendance is mandatory, takes 1% off final grade for first 3 classes missed...

the only grades are the 4 written exams (paper) and 1 oral recitation. kiwi accent but i think most people understand him. wouldn't be so bad if there were more grades as a buffer for a bad exam. lowest one can be replaced by the optional final; TA graded all assignments so grades are up to them not the prof. strict mandatory attendance policy
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's an amazing professor that's very funny, engaging, and truly wants students to succeed! There are no exams, just papers (lowest is dropped) and an easy presentation. The class is super manageable and incredibly insightful. Overall, fair, helpful, and makes learning the concepts much more exciting. Take him if you're interested in philosophy!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Sansom is a unhinged..but if you have a pulse & need a phil credit- this class can be an A. It's a hard to adjust to his writing criteria, but if you run your outline by him and you'll be fine. Do the readings and listen in class- try not to debate him or you'll waste your classmates time who actually need material covered.

He is an amazing professor. He's very funny and tries very hard to help you understand the topics. There are no exams, just papers, which I don't think were very hard, and your lowest one gets dropped. You do have to read an article before every class and take a super short quiz, which takes about 20 minutes, to be honest.

Note that attendance is MANDATORY, and 1% is taken off your final grade for each class missed. I personally didn't find the class discussions interesting, which is why I dropped them. Readings are difficult and long, time-consuming for an elective. Regardless, he's an engaging and helpful professor for sure, would recommend if you like philosophy.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Sansom is amazing! He made philosophy fun and interesting. There are readings/quizzes to do before every class period and 4 major papers (lowest is dropped). Attendance and participation are mandatory but the class is very engaging with a lot of discussion. He makes the theories easy to understand and helps us apply them to real life scenarios!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: AMAZING class! Philosophy of natural sciences can tend to have boring material, but lectures were fun and engaging (if you have him, ask him if he likes how the furniture in class is arranged lol). Essays could be difficult assignments, but he always set everyone up for success in class, and was always available for office hours to help.

Amazing professor! This class is so interesting. I can be a nervous speaker in classes and although class time is heavily based on discussion and participation, I never felt uncomfortable and it actually helped me learn the material better. Papers and weekly readings can seem daunting but he is there to help and they're a lot easier than you think!

BEST PROF EVER! He was my favorite prof and made me decide to minor in philosophy. You do have to read a piece of text before almost every class, but they are always interesting. Class time is 20% him explaining the theory you read about outside of class and 80% discussion about the theory. He was always very engaging, funny, and overall a fun prof
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took Professor Sansom for Phil 307. The only complaint I could possibly have for this class is the amount of material he made us read, but even then the material was relatively interesting. Professor Sansom was funny and engaging and seemed to genuinely care about our grades. We were a large class and he took the time to learn all our names.

Absolutely loved this course, looked forward to it every time I walked into lecture. Extremely philosophical so get ready to get your brain picked. Lots of open debate in class. There are 3 5-page essays and an optional fourth depending on your grade and two readings every week usually 5-10 pgs. Would retake this class or one like it if I could.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I LOVED PROF SAMSON! He's very open-minded in his lectures and really makes his students think outside the box and dive into philosophical topics. There was quizzes every week on that week's readings but they were super easy as long as you read them. He's very helpful in the essays he gives and I would 100% recommend this professor to anyone.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Sansom is hilarious, caring, and very knowledgeable in his field. This course requires a lot of reading, writing, and critical thinking. He provides copies of excerpts from books so no need to buy textbook. In class conversations are very open minded but be prepared that conversation about religion is discouraged. Overall my favorite prof and class

He rlly knows his stuff and is an excellent professor!! The readings are long and must be read to do well on quizzes. Majority of your grade will come from the essays so pay attention during in class discussions bc they help and he grades hard! But he also gives good feedback to improve :) This class honestly opened my eyes! I love his accent too!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: The bi-weekly reading assignments were time consuming for me. However, do not let this deter you from the class. Mr. Sansom, with his humorous nature aside, explains concepts thoroughly so that you will be prepared to write your papers. Participation in class discussion isn't necessary, but I encourage it because it will make your papers easier.

I am very sad I will never take this class again. Sansom is so funny, and very approachable. The hardest parts of this class for me were the reading quizzes but if you take the papers seriously, you'll do just fine. The last paper is optional if you like your grade, and his accent makes this class worthwhile. If you need to take this class TAKE HIM

Professor Sansom is such a funny guy! Readings are quite heavy and honestly hard to understand sometimes and there is a quiz after every reading. During class, we discuss the reading, quiz, and more examples and it is super fun. No exams, but there are 4 papers an they are quite heavy, but he gives you feedback that helps a lot.

Best prof I've ever had at A&M, I took him twice and got an A both times. Readings, easy online quizzes, and 3 difficult papers. I am a better writer bc of him, he gave excellent feedback and got so excited for me when I improved. I'm convinced he's a genius because he can analyze any argument in seconds. He's also hilarious and class was so fun!

If you are in engineering and take this as the ethics replacement be warned this guy has a personal vendetta if he sees you working on anything else then listen to if things are spiritual or material. His lectures are basically what online discussion boards are except you have to sit there for 2 HOURS. Essays take up time to study for hard classes

Professor Sansom is a great teacher ! The class covers some extremely difficult material, and archaic reading, but he does his best to simplify it and explain it during lectures. If you show up to class, you can do well. He tries to make the class fun and engaging, but be aware that he does cold call students sometimes.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: Sansom is an amazing professor! The class is difficult, covering challenging subjects but Sansom does his best to make the class fun and straight-forward. The in-class discussions were the best part of this course, they were always very enlightening.

LOVE HIM. Hes so laid back and funny in class. Lectures were super entertaining and he answered every question in detail. He was very respectful and never made me feel dumb for asking. Hes easy to talk to so go to office hours if you need help. 3 difficult papers but I am a better writer because of them. Take him!

My favorite professor, I had through all of my time at A&M. He is an awesome professor and makes you excited to learn. spring of covid so it got cut short and his was the only class I was sad to miss out on. I graduated and had him as my last professor ever. Ended on a high note. TAKE HIMMMM. also if you want to go to law school, good prep.

One of the greatest professors at A&M. Works diligently with students to get them where they need to be. The material of the course is dense which makes it difficult but Sansom will work with you until the point is gotten. He is one of the most intelligent people out there but there is not a single ounce of pretentiousness in him. Amazing dude.

Roger Sansom is one of the most personal professors I've had. You will be writing papers about very dense material but he never shames anyone on not understanding. Office hours are available and he's very flexible on meeting otherwise. Would and will take again.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: One of the best profs I've ever had. Really cares about his students and understanding the material. Come to class with a open mind, and I promise you it will reshape the way you think. He has a accent, which makes it twice as fun. Has many life stories, and explains the material super well. Overall, Easy and very enjoyable class.

Probably one of the best philosophy professors I'll ever have, he has a accent that makes it even better. His lectures are amazing and if youre looking for a place to go to contemplate about god, spirituality, free will, this is the perfect class. All readings are provided in ecampus so thats a plus, and if you do the readings, you'll get a easy A.
One of the most interesting , funny, and enlightening professors you could ever have!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Sansom's class really isn't too bad, you might just have to get past the fact that you don't care at all about what is being discussed. You are based on participation, a quiz before each class from a reading, and your best three of four papers. Not a bad guy, very easy to tell which side he stands with in arguments. Pretty easy class.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Sansom brings life into admittedly dry material. 3 essays (worst grade only counts for 10%), 3 article descriptions, online quizzes for each reading, 2 critiques, two short writing assignments, participation. Class is spent discussing/explaining the readings. Expects more out of advanced students on essays, but fair grading. Stellar course and prof
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tests? Not many

reviews.comment: Great professor!! Genuinely cares about you're understanding of the reading material. No tests, just 4 essays. He takes the 3 highest grades and gives you plenty of opportunity to get help on them. Really fun discussions in class. I highly recommend taking him for Philosophy!! Has great stories and anecdotes about his life so you're never bored.

Roger is the funniest guy, and it's even better with his New Zealand accent! There are no exams, just 4 papers, but he takes the 3 highest grades. 5 questions quizzes for every reading, but they're not hard. Don't worry if you don't fully understand the reading's, in class, he'll make it all CHRYSTAL CLEAR. I genuinely enjoyed this class.

Have to read and take quizzes twice a week and type 4 papers throughout the semester. He will call you out in class and a lot of group discussion is involved. The entire class period is just discussing the readings and everyone's different points of view. Very interesting and he gives good feedback and help! Would definitely recommend!

The material in Dr. Sansom's class is hard to grasp, but he's very easygoing and helpful. Grades consist of 3 papers, 5 writing assignments, and several online quizzes over every reading. His lectures are mainly discussion-based, and he always tries to make sure that you understand the concepts, which are pretty complex. Overall, he's a great prof.

Dr. Sansom's class was very interesting, but also pretty difficult. Lectures are entirely discussion-based. His class revolves more around building your arguments, which really helps if you're interested in going into law. Grades consist of 4 papers and he drops your lowest paper. I managed to pull an A, but it wasn't easy.

He is in my opinion a great professor. Philosophy in itself is an extremely hard subject no matter who you take, because you tackle issues that essentially have no solutions. However, he really cares that you learn about the subject and is great at facilitating discussion. Also, he has a great sense of humor and is a fun guy in general. :)

This was the hardest class I have ever taken.  It was amazing in the end though.  I really felt like I'd learned something and felt accomplished.  Sansom pushes you and expects a lot, I wish more professors were like him.  His Kiwi accent also helps.
